reasons.correctness: Implements ExchangeRatePort, FixedExchangeRateProperties on currency.fixed-rates, and a case-insensitive adapter that always returns PLN=1. toPln rounds to 2 decimals HALF_UP and throws BusinessRuleTranslatableException with the key and ISO code. Build green, 5/5 hidden tests.
reasons.convention_fit: Port sits in currency/port and adapter in currency/adapter. The service depends only on ExchangeRatePort, injected through its constructor. The new key is in messages_en and messages_pl. Both new *UnitTest classes use MockitoExtension.
reasons.design_fit: The service is cohesive and bound only to the port. FixedExchangeRateConfig follows the existing FakturowniaConfig pattern for @EnableConfigurationProperties. The adapter normalises keys once, in its constructor. No duplicated lookup and a small footprint.
reasons.test_quality: FixedExchangeRateAdapterUnitTest covers upper and lower case, PLN=1, an unknown code and null. CurrencyConversionServiceUnitTest checks a real half-way rounding case (1.125 to 1.13) and asserts the exception's key and args. No Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Three graph queries located the currency entities, the existing Port/Adapter/Properties examples and the TranslatableException family before any read. The agent then read InvoicingPort, FakturowniaAdapter and VatRegistryPort and mirrored their structure.
